A '''Weapon''' is a [[Star Wars CCG]] card type. Weapons have these subtypes:

* [[Character Weapon]] (Weapon — Character) — deploys on a warrior
* [[Starship Weapon]] (Weapon — Starship) — deploys on a starship
* [[Automated Weapon]] (Weapon — Automated) — typically deploys at a site (mines, seekers)
* [[Artillery Weapon]] (Weapon — Artillery) — crewed site weapon (not in Premiere)
* [[Vehicle Weapon]] (Weapon — Vehicle) — deploys on a vehicle (not in Premiere)

Premiere examples: [[Jedi Lightsaber]], [[Vader's Lightsaber]], [[Proton Torpedoes]], [[Timer Mine]].
